main_body: Wooden scroll shelf (bookcase) with a dark interior, several shelf boards and scrolls/items, drawn straight from the front
top_band: Rows 1-2 light tan (#d6b37e), then a 1-row edge (#ac7238). It is only 2-3 rows, and the same wood family as the frame below. It reads as a top rim, not a surface.
evidence: The column at x=16 shows a 2-row light tan top (rows 1-2) and a 1-row edge (row 3), then a dark interior (L=56) from rows 4-10 and onward. The shelf boards are thin horizontal 1-row lines (L 153/99) seen face-on, not shelf tops seen from above. The compartments are an open dark interior drawn flat, with no visible shelf surfaces. This matches the guide's red 'front elevation: top 1' and 'rim only: top 2' cases, not the green cabinet with a top of 5 rows. Top is only 2 rows, with no eave shadow beneath it (row 4 is the dark interior, not a shadow under an overhang). The thin rim hat on a front elevation fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has 19 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, 32 distinct colours against 38-40, and 9% flat fill, below the stall's 13%. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted brown, in the material tone. The wood has several steps (tan, orange, mid brown, dark brown) and the items (scrolls, blue cloth, red books, gold) add variety. The dark interior is a fairly large flat dark-brown area, but it is broken up by shelves and items. Overall it holds up beside the references.
